response.earliest_time: within one hour of the signal

paths.new_costs_and_risks: Preparation time is spent even if the event succeeds.
paths.assumption: Registrations convert to attendance at the usual rate.
paths.event: A transit strike on the event day cuts attendance below the viable threshold.
paths.mechanism: Most participants rely on one transit line; no remote fallback exists, so a strike removes them at once.
paths.early_signal: Strike notice published in local news three days before the event.
paths.consequence: Workshop runs below viable size and the fixed venue cost is wasted.
paths.stop_condition: If confirmed attendance drops below 15 by the day before, postpone instead of running.

plan.plan: Run a one-day community workshop for 40 registered participants.
plan.horizon: event day plus one week of preparation
plan.success: At least 30 participants attend and the closing survey averages 4 of 5.
plan.failure: Fewer than 15 participants attend or the venue becomes unusable.
plan.hard_constraints: Fixed venue booking; total budget cap; no paid advertising.
